source_signature.notes: Batch 4G skill 3/5. Scope Operator-derived. The synthesis skill: constructs the COMPLETE shear and moment diagrams across the whole beam by TRAVERSING with the load-shear-moment relations (from shear_moment_load_relationships, skill 2), not by re-solving section equilibrium at many cuts. Consumes the point-value siblings (shear/bending at a cut) and the relations node. Boundary: skill 2 supplies the relations (dV/dx=-w, dM/dx=V, areas, jumps, degrees) - cited, not re-derived; the single-cut skills give values consistent with the diagram at a cut but are not the construction method; maximum_moment_from_zero_shear (skill 4, downstream) specializes in extracting the numeric GLOBAL-MAX moment - this skill builds the diagram and labels the V=0 peak value but does NOT reframe the deliverable as global-max extraction. Worked example Operator-re-derived, same SS 6 m/w=4/Ay=By=12 family: V by traversal - jump +12 at A, V(x)=12-4x, V(3)=0, V(6-)=-12, jump +12 at B -> 0, closes, linear under UDL. M from area under V - M(0)=0, area 0-3 = +(1/2)(3)(12)=18 -> M(3)=18, area 3-6 = -18 -> M(6)=0, closes at the simple support, parabolic under UDL. Peak M=18 kN·m at x=3 where V=0. FOUR-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 3 (V-jump senses, slope sense, peak placement), solution_sequencing_error at step 4, unclassified at step 7. solution_sequencing_error is GENUINELY EARNED here - the strongest home in the batch: step 4 is a real order-gate, the M diagram is the area under V so building M before the V diagram is determined strands the area-under-V prerequisite (M is mathematically underivable, not merely out of preferred order), and the trigger is evidence-gated on the out-of-order construction, never inferred from a wrong final number. This contrasts with its correct OMISSION on the batch's single-cut skills (frame single-cut siblings, shear, bending-moment, and the relations node), where no authored step stranded a prerequisite; the signal is placed by error model, not recency. axis_confusion omitted (no component-resolution step). simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Diagrams built by traversal, closure verified (V->0 after last reaction, M=0 at simple ends), degrees correct (parabolic M under UDL). Unlocks maximum_moment_from_zero_shear (skill 4).
